cli_streams.why: Raw CLI stdout and stderr are unfiltered tool logs that may carry account or session details, and they are large. They are kept verbatim, out of version control; their hashes are recorded here and in each run record. A scan for the operator's e-mail address and common credential patterns found none (2026-09-25).
